blocks.h2: What a Geneva Plumbing Inspection Covers

steps.body: Age, leaks, relief valve, venting and a flush if it's due.
A test cycle, float, check valve and backup.
Whether your softener is still needed or set right for today's city water.
Slow drains, gurgling and a [camera inspection](/geneva/video-camera-sewer-inspections) if needed.
Galvanized condition, leaks and shutoffs that won't close.
What's fine, what to plan for and what needs attention.

blocks.intro: Geneva's homes span almost two centuries, and both ends benefit from regular checkups.

items.body: Homes from the 1800s and early 1900s often have galvanized supply pipe, cast iron drains and clay sewer lines. A checkup tells you which parts are wearing out.
More than 4 in 10 homes were built after 1990. Many still have original water heaters and sump pumps that are due.

items.h3: Softeners Set for the Old Water
items.body: If your softener dates from before 2008, it may be set far higher than today's water needs.

blocks.h2: Plumbing Maintenance Questions From Geneva Homeowners

items.q: How often should my plumbing be inspected?
items.preview: Once a year, ideally in spring.
items.answer: Once a year works for most Geneva homes. Spring lets us test the sump pump before heavy rain.

items.q: What do you look at in a historic home?
items.preview: Pipe materials, drains and the sewer line.
items.answer: We look closely at galvanized supply pipe, cast iron drains and the sewer lateral, plus any updates made over the years.

items.q: Will you check my water softener?
items.preview: Yes, including whether you still need it.
items.answer: Yes. With Geneva's softened city water, we'll tell you whether yours is still needed and set correctly.
Yes. The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) is our yearly plan that brings a plumber to your home for regular maintenance.

items.q: Can you check whether I still need my water softener?
items.preview: Yes. We test the water during the visit.
items.answer: Yes. We test your water and look at the softener's settings. With Geneva's reverse osmosis treated water, you may be able to turn it down or remove it.

items.q: How much does a plumbing inspection cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on the home and what's included. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the size of the home and add-ons like a sewer camera inspection or water heater flush. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
